name: latent_sakuga_mma_vs_mma
shot_contract: One continuous hand-drawn anime martial arts action cut inside a rain-slicked neon-lit rooftop helipad cage arena overlooking a dark cyberpunk skyline, harsh magenta-and-cyan floodlights reflecting off wet concrete, octagonal chain-link perimeter fence in deep background shadow. Expressive hand-drawn character animation with flat two-tone cel shadows, crisp anatomical ink outlines, and clear spacing contrast between brief loaded holds and whip-fast transfers. Keep Fighter A strictly on screen-left facing right and Fighter B strictly on screen-right facing left throughout the entire cut with zero side swaps and zero on-screen text.
initial_state: Fighter A (screen-left, facing right): lean, razor-cut Muay Thai and MMA striker, shirtless bare torso, white cloth tape on both wrists/knuckles and gold ankle wraps, midnight-blue Vale Tudo fight shorts, bare feet. Fighter B (screen-right, facing left): heavyweight muscular Dutch kickboxer, shirtless broad scarred torso, urban-camo fight shorts, bare wrists and bare ankles with NO tape, bare feet. Both fighters begin grounded at long kicking distance where an extended leg bridges the gap with both left and right arms visible outside their torso silhouettes.
observation_contract: Maintain a readable front-hemisphere lateral and three-quarter camera view that keeps both fighters head-to-toe in frame and exposes every limb-to-target contact in profile. Never orbit across the center line, and never conceal a required block, parry, or strike behind an early flash or torso overlap.
